model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and F1 score for three different methods. The x-axis is labeled "epoch (次)" and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 18, with tick labels at every 2 epoch intervals. The y-axis is labeled "F1 分数" and represents a linear scale ranging from 0.55 to 0.90. A red, square-marker line, labeled "lattice," begins at 0.598 at epoch 0 and increases to 0.853 at epoch 16. A blue, circle-marker line, labeled "FLAT," begins at 0.698 at epoch 0 and increases to 0.835 at epoch 16. An orange, triangle-marker line, labeled "OURS," begins at 0.753 at epoch 0 and increases to 0.873 at epoch 16.
